name: DSMR-reader
description: Today’s electricity, gas and costs from your DSMR-reader
comment: API v2, consumption/today, checked against the source (src/dsmr_api, branch v6): since v3.1 the API reference only ships inside an installation. The API is off until it is switched on under Configuration, API. kWh and m³ are inferred from the meter readings. Without readings today the answer is a plain JSON string instead of an object. The live power is at /api/v2/consumption/electricity-live (currently_delivered in W) for a second custom API.
